access_boundary: This record represents the MiMo-V2.6-Pro-RL release announced September 22, 2026, the flagship tier of the MiMo-V2.6 line. The MiMo-V2.6-Flash sibling, the reviewed V2 and V2.5 records, and the Pro UltraSpeed serving mode (excluded as an alias) are separate boundaries.
strengths: Fully open weights under a declared MIT grant with a technical report and RL harnesses
A distinct flagship tier marketed as the most powerful open-source model in its class
tradeoffs: The 1.02-trillion-parameter MoE is a serious self-hosting burden
Evaluations are vendor-reported and the release is days old with immature community verification
